g.aria-label: Two Joint Factorizations Define Three Shift Regimes
1. Covariate Shift: p(x) Drifts, p(y|x) Fixed [Causal: x → y]
p(x,y) = p(x)p(y|x): photo vs cartoon style changes, but cat pixels mean cat
2. Label Shift: Class Priors p(y) Drift, p(x|y) Fixed [Causal: y → x]
p(x,y) = p(y)p(x|y): winter flu surge raises p(flu) while symptoms stay fixed
3. Concept Shift: Conditional Rule p(y|x) Drifts [Needs fresh labels]
"Soda" vs "pop" across geography or evolving diagnostic criteria over time
